name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
description: The national old-age pension for citizens aged 60 and above who belong to a BPL household. Payout is Rs 200 per month (age 60-79) and Rs 500 per month (age 80+) plus state top-ups. Doorstep, offline and online application channels exist.
illustrative_rules: The applicant must be at least 60 years old (verifiable from the Aadhaar date of birth) and belong to a BPL household (verifiable from the ration card category). The bank passbook must show the applicant's name so the pension can be credited. State top-ups vary by state.
notes: The Rs 200 / Rs 500 monthly rates and the 60+ age criterion follow the central scheme. State-specific top-ups and application rules may differ.

process.name: Old-age pension application review
process.description: Before the application is submitted for the pension, we check the applicant's age, the BPL status and the bank account details.

name_check.description: The applicant's name on the Aadhaar, ration card and passbook must refer to the same person.

requirements.name: Minimum age
requirements.message: The Aadhaar date of birth makes the applicant {{age}} years old. The pension requires the applicant to be at least 60.
requirements.suggestion: Only applicants aged 60 and above are eligible on the day the application is reviewed.

requirements.name: BPL household
requirements.message: The ration card category is '{{value}}' — the pension is for Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
requirements.suggestion: Confirm the household's Below Poverty Line status before applying.

required_document_messages.aadhaar: Aadhaar card — to verify identity, age and address.
required_document_messages.ration_card: Ration card — to verify the BPL household category.
required_document_messages.bank_passbook: Bank passbook — the pension is credited to this account each month.

states.label: Upload documents

states.label: Check documents

states.label: Attention needed

states.label: Final review
